pending_interview.question: A mid-sized logistics company comes to you wanting to replace their manual shipment-tracking process with an AI-powered system. They want customers to get real-time updates on where their shipments are, and they want internal ops teams to get automated alerts when a shipment is likely to be delayed. They have a small engineering team of four people, no existing ML infrastructure, and a six-month timeline. Walk me through how you would scope this engagement — what you'd need to learn, what you'd build versus buy, and what tradeoffs you'd make explicit to the client before writing a single line of code.
